svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: GKE application platform on Google Cloud
svg.desc: GKE application platform on Google Cloud. 12 components in 8 groups. Connections: Developers to App repository (git push); App repository to Cloud Build (trigger); Cloud Build to Artifact Registry (push image); Cloud Build to Cloud Deploy (create release); Cloud Deploy to GKE cluster shop (roll out); Artifact Registry to GKE cluster shop (pull image); Pods to Memorystore (private IP); Pods to Cloud SQL (private IP); Pods to Secret Manager (Workload Identity); Observability to GKE cluster shop (logs and metrics).

text.tspan: GKE APPLICATION PLATFORM ON GOOGLE CLOUD
Cloud Build turns each push into an image in Artifact Registry and a Cloud Deploy release that rolls out to a regional GKE cluster
DELIVERY, IMAGE PULLS AND DATA ACCESS
